data: In which plot do we see a curve color other than green and orange?

The question asks about a curve color other than green and orange. From the caption, we know that the green line represents the Original (ESIM) model, and the orange line represents the Original (DA) model. Therefore, any other color would be considered other than green and orange.

Looking at the plots, we can see that the pink line appears in one of the subfigures. This indicates that there is a curve color other than green and orange in the figure.

Thus, the answer is: The pink line in subfigure (c) represents a curve color other than green and orange.
